entries.english:
# Lamitype Customized Dictionary
# =============================
#
# One rule per line, in this format:
#
#     what you say  ->  what gets typed
#
# Use this to fix recurring transcription errors: proper nouns the
# speech model always mishears, acronyms that come out spelled out,
# technical terms with non-standard phonetics, etc.
#
# Rules:
#   • Lines starting with #  are comments (ignored)
#   • Blank lines are ignored
#   • Source is CASE-INSENSITIVE: "cloud code", "Cloud Code", and
#     "CLOUD CODE" all match the same rule. The target is inserted
#     literally, so the output always matches what you wrote.
#   • Plain string match only; no regex, no wildcards
#   • Longest match wins when rules overlap
#   • Changes take effect on the next transcription (no restart)
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Examples (delete the # at the start of a line to activate it)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

# Proper nouns the model mis-transcribes:
# 拍粉       -> Python
# Cloud code -> Claude Code
# Enfropic   -> Anthropic

# Acronym normalization:
# U I U X    -> UI/UX

# Technical jargon:
# J.S.O.N    -> JSON

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Your entries below:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
entries.zh-Hant-TW:

# ==================
#
# 每行一條規則，格式如下：
#

entries.english: ASR decoder max generated tokens per segment. Larger budgets cost more decoder KV cache per call and risk runaway generation past EOS. Speech-swift default is 448, validated stable on the 15-min long session test. Bumping past 1024 has been observed to push unified memory off a cliff.
entries.zh-Hant-TW: 每個區段的 ASR 解碼器最大產生 token 數。額度越大，每次呼叫會使用越多解碼器 KV cache，並可能在 EOS 後持續失控產生內容。Speech-swift 預設值為 448，已在 15 分鐘長時間工作階段測試中驗證穩定。觀察到提高至 1024 以上時，統一記憶體用量會急遽增加。
entries.translator_comment: live_caption.json documentation; technical terms and exact numeric semantics remain.

entries.english: MLX GPU buffer pool cap in MB. Lower = less RAM but cold transcribes; higher = warm cache. 128 was too tight; 1024 is the perf-tuned default on Apple Silicon. Drop to 256 or 512 if you want a tighter RAM ceiling.
entries.zh-Hant-TW: MLX GPU 緩衝池上限（MB）。較低 = RAM 使用量較少，但每次轉錄都需冷啟動；較高 = 使用暖快取。128 太低；1024 是針對 Apple Silicon 效能調校的預設值。若要更嚴格限制 RAM，可降至 256 或 512。
